messages:
Jules: Customer reported 400 from /invoke when calling payments tool. Error: "additionalProperties: 'context_info'". They also sent billing_profile as a plain string. Can someone sanity-check?
Aisha: Can you paste the payload + error? link to logs? :eyes:
Jules: Here is the payload and server response:
```json
{
  "tool": "payments.charge",
  "billing_profile": "acct_12345",
  "amount": 2500,
  "currency": "usd",
  "context_info": "checkout_v1"
}
```
Server returned 400:
```json
{"error":"schema validation","details":{"keyword":"additionalProperties","message":"context_info is not allowed","path":"/"}}
```
Evan: Hmm router chooses tool by matching FunctionSchema required props + types. In this model billing_profile is expected to be OBJECT {id, type} not a plain string. Also schema has "additionalProperties": false so context_info fails. Why did client change billing_profile to string?
Devon: Could be old SDK that coerced BillingProfile -> string. We saw a similar shim in payments-sdk v0.9. Quick repro: try with billing_profile as object and drop context_info.
Jules: Repro curl (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tool":"payments.charge","billing_profile":{"id":"acct_12345","method":"card"},"amount":2500,"currency":"usd"}'
```
Jules: Repro curl (fails with original payload):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tool":"payments.charge","billing_profile":"acct_12345","amount":2500,"currency":"usd","context_info":"checkout_v1"}'
```
Aisha: Quick triage: escalate to eng-runtime + SDK team. Sounds like two issues: (1) SDK changed billing_profile shape; (2) runtime strict additionalProperties is rejecting customer metadata. Both are valid concerns. :warning:
Evan: For short-term we can adjust router to first coerce billing_profile string -> {id: str} if customer is on legacy SDK and then validate. Also consider adding an allowlist for a top-level "metadata"/"context" field instead of rejecting everything.
Devon: I'll open a PR to runtime to relax additionalProperties at top-level for tool selection. If we do that, we must make sure function schema still enforces required fields and types.
Jules: Created INC ticket and linked customer. Support-Bot: INC-4521 created and assigned to eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:
Aisha: Plan: (1) hotfix router coercion, (2) SDK patch to stop serializing billing_profile as string, (3) opt-in metadata field mapping. Devon/Evan take ownership. Jules will update customer.
Devon: I'll target a patch tomorrow, will add test cases for string->object coercion and extra top-level keys.
Jules: Thanks team, I'll post a short customer note once we have the hotfix timeline. :thumbsup:
